_comment: A campaign: every job that should become a report, with the paths that differ between them.
Copy this next to a run directory as reports/jobs.json, edit, then run:
Relative paths resolve against the catalog's parent's parent, i.e. the run directory it lives
in; pass --root to override. Fields left out fall back to defaults or to the engine's own.
Keys per entry: name (also the parse-cache file name), run_dir, out_dir, engine (auto),
phases, rocprof_dir, trace_root, torch_trace {phase: path}, no_auto_traces, max_msg_bytes,

reports.name: sgl_gptoss_2p2d_balanced
reports.note: GPT-OSS-120B 2P2D, profiled without rocprofv3; the run where the proxy used both decode replicas evenly

reports.name: primus_llama70b_4n
reports.note: Primus training, both datatype phases in one job; traces resolve per datatype from the tensorboard paths
